featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Safco Motors was extremely disappointing and frustrating. These people are absolutely not trustworthy. Before taking the payment, they will be all over you – calls, messages, follow-ups – acting like everything is super professional. But the moment the car is sold, they completely disappear.

There were several issues with the car that they promised to fix after delivery – but no one followed up, no calls, no updates. When you try to reach out, they act like they don’t know anything and pretend to be professional with lines like ‘Sir, please call us’ or ‘Please share your details’ – when in reality, they already know the full issue. It’s just a show.

There’s absolutely zero professionalism here. They don’t know how to deal with customers once the sale is done. No accountability, no responsibility – just fake smiles and false promises.

I strongly advise anyone planning to buy a car from Safco Motors – please double-check everything on your own. Don’t fall for their sweet talk. Once the deal is closed, you’re on your own. Be extremely cautious before trusting them.”

featured_reviews.name: Toufik Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Moin Bhai,
Im writing this to express my extreme dissatisfaction with you. Car purchase karne se pehle apne Jo bhi commitment di thi regarding documentation, jo aapne puri nahi ki, jiske liye mujhe apse follow up/calls karne padte rahe. Aap calls ignore kar rahe aur call back bhi nahi kiya, isi se pata chalata hai ki sare commitment jo aapne kiye the car purchase se pehle wo sare false hai aur unacceptable hai. Ek baar apne car ki full payment leli uske baad aap completely irresponsible ho gaye aur apki taraf se koi ownership nahi dikhi, aapke RTO agent(ye bhi fake agent hai jo aapke hi liye koi kaam karta hai) ko bhi mujhe call karke apko confirm karana pada ki RTO transfer nahi kiya hai. Ye sab se ye dikhta hai ki kitna poor business ethics se aap kaam kar rahe ho, 4-5 hajar rupees ke kharch se nahi aap bahot amir ho jaoge na me garib lekin, business me jaban ki kimat bahot hoti hai, jab samne wala pura payment karke aap pe trust karta hai. AAP bole ki aapka kharch jada hogaya gadi ownership transfer me, ye kaise possible hai kya aap pehli baar car sale kar rahe ho? Aapne 1 hazar upar kharch nahi kiya ownership transfer me aur bills mange par reply nahi de rahe ho.
Mera aap pe trust karne ka reason ek tha ki aap imaan islam follow karte ho, jisse akhirat ka khauf se insaan galat kam aur jaban se mukharta nahi hai. Lekin apne mujhe galat sabit kiya aur ye sikhaya ki har imaan wale pe trust nahi kar sakte.
Ye to pehla experience hai mera ki paperwork me fraud hogaya, ab aage pata nahi ki aur kya ayenga car me. Koi harz nahi islaam mauf karna hai sikhata hai, allah apko akhirat me nawaje!
featured_reviews.review_translated_text:
Moin Bhai,
I am writing this to express my extreme dissatisfaction with you. You haven't fulfilled any commitments you made regarding documentation before purchasing the car, requiring me to follow up/call you. You're ignoring my calls and haven't even called back, which shows that all the commitments you made before purchasing the car are false and unacceptable. Once you took the full payment for your car, you became completely irresponsible and no ownership was seen from your side, your RTO agent (this too is a fake agent who works for you) also had to call me and confirm that the RTO transfer has not been done. All this shows with what complete business ethics you are working, by spending 4-5 thousand rupees you will not become very rich nor I will become poor, but in business, the price of your tongue is very high, when the other person trusts you by making the full payment. You said that you would have incurred a lot of expenses in the car ownership transfer, how is this possible, are you selling a car for the first time? You did not spend more than 1000 rupees in the ownership transfer and are not replying when asked for bills.
One of the reasons for me to trust you was that you follow Islam, due to which a person does not commit any wrong act or speak wrong words due to the fear of the hereafter. But you proved me wrong and taught me that we cannot trust every person with faith.
This is my first experience that there might be fraud in the paperwork, now I do not know what else will happen in the car. There is no harm, Islam teaches to forgive, may Allah bless you in the end!

featured_reviews.name: roney sandao
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I would like to genuinely appreciate the efforts of Inderjit Cars Pvt. Ltd. and especially Service Advisor Ali for finally resolving a long pending and frustrating issue with my Tata Nexon EV.

I had been facing repeated problems in my vehicle for quite some time, including:
• Door auto lock/unlock malfunction
• Apple CarPlay/USB disconnecting repeatedly
• Blower and AC related issues
• Warning lights and random running issues
• Noise from side sensors/panels
• Rusting and paint peeling on doors and dicky areas

The disappointing part was that some of these exact issues had already been reported during my previous service visit, but unfortunately they were not properly diagnosed or resolved at that time. This led to repeated follow-ups, workshop visits, and unnecessary inconvenience.

However, during this latest visit, the experience was completely different. Ali personally got involved in the entire process, maintained proper communication, created a WhatsApp group for updates, and ensured the car was thoroughly inspected instead of just doing temporary fixes.

After detailed diagnosis, the actual root causes were identified:
• Faulty door switch issue
• Blower unit filled heavily with dust, which was causing multiple electrical and functional issues

Once these were properly cleaned and fixed, all the ongoing problems were finally resolved. The car now feels completely normal and smooth again.

I truly appreciate the professionalism, patience, involvement, and commitment shown by Ali throughout the process. This level of attention and customer handling genuinely restored my confidence in the service experience.

I only hope that such detailed diagnosis and customer support is provided from the first visit itself for every customer. But credit where it’s due — this time the issue was handled properly and resolved completely.

Thank you again to the team and especially Ali for finally solving the problem

featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely poor level of service by this service centre. 29th Nov I took my car for service got it back on 30th. 2 years back in Feb 23 I had used this service centre. featured_reviews.name: PRADIPTA SENGUPTA OFFICIAL
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction regarding the recent servicing of my car at your authorized service centre in Jogeshwari West, under Tata Motors.

Today, I had given my vehicle for its scheduled 3-year service, strictly following the guidelines mentioned in the instruction manual. However, I regret to inform you that several procedures were carried out beyond what was recommended, which appears unnecessary and profit-driven.

As per the service manual:

Wheel alignment was required, but I was strongly insisted (jabardasti) upon to opt for wheel balancing as well, which was not mandatory.

Spark plugs were replaced without any necessity at this stage. Which was not compulsory.

Coolant replacement was carried out despite it not being due as per the prescribed schedule.

These additions were neither properly justified nor aligned with the manufacturer’s guidelines, leading to avoidable extra expenses.

It is quite disheartening to experience such practices from an authorized service centre. I sincerely hope this matter is taken seriously. Though I understand that a standard reply may be issued, I request you to look into this issue carefully and take appropriate corrective action to maintain customer trust. You are looking forward only earning profit from the customers.
I know you will reply a typical answer like every post.
